assumptions: Filter is a 4D Cartesian [x,y,vx,vy] Kalman filter, not the paper's 5D coordinated-turn range-bearing model.
Mahalanobis gate (9.21) and physical gate (10 m) are engineering additions.
Score hyperparameters lambda_s=0.95, lambda_t=4, S_c=1.0, P_B=0.05, P_FA=0.02, P_D=0.90 are chosen values, not paper-verified.
lost_expiry=15 is an engineering addition to allow same-ID recovery across a short gap.
reappearance_reward=0.0 means a recovered track uses only the documented association increment.
dynamic_score uses the docs/plan/IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md missed increment log((1-P_FA)/(1-P_D)); with P_D>P_FA this is positive (a documented-formula limitation, reported not silently changed).
dynamic_score_corrected is a diagnostic variant using the sign-corrected penalty log((1-P_D)/(1-P_FA)); it is an engineering correction, not a paper-verified formula.
